game.title: Wordweave
game.description: Intercept scrambled signals in a sci-fi word puzzle. Connect letters on the wheel to recover hidden words and find bonus transmissions.
game.controls: Slide across the letter wheel and release to submit. Keyboard: type letters, Enter to submit, Backspace to undo or Escape to clear.

artwork.alt: A teal and amber sci-fi signal decoder displaying an intercepted waveform.

cover.alt: A teal and amber sci-fi signal decoder displaying an intercepted waveform.
